slides.title: Nth highest [[query]]
Bonus: [[dept-wise]] Nth
slides.note: Interviewer ka next sawaal yahi hota hai, ready raho 😎

slides.wrong:
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  ORDER BY salary DESC)
... WHERE rn = 3
slides.right:
DENSE_RANK() OVER (
  ORDER BY salary DESC)
... WHERE rnk = 3
slides.why: ROW_NUMBER tie ko alag number deta → rn 3 = **70,000** (galat!) 💀

points: CTE mein rank, bahar **WHERE rnk = N**
